scale: Original judges' scale: the three code-blind judges of each row's original lane round, on the committed sheet (CPU Low/Compatibility frames, except the NPC face round's GPU Medium frames). Some rows were acceptances, others reopened rounds (F10#2 r3, the F36 gap round). The 7.5 bar and the 6.7 CPU-provisional bar were set against this scale. 'reference' is the side's three-judge mean.
rules: Judges never see this file, any key, any arm name or any reference score.
Use anchor_tiles.py to cut, mask and re-letter tiles; never hand a judge the raw sheet.
box and masks are pixel rectangles [x0, y0, x1, y1] on the committed sheet; masks are blanked before cropping.
Add an anchor only from a committed sheet with a committed key and a recorded three-judge mean.

anchors.judge_brief: Named wild-creature fight in a dense storm forest (Stormwood): one fight, one-second interval frames (iNN) plus the enemy's telegraphed attacks (tell1/tell2 a-f, start to recovery). Does the fight read on screen - both fighters (the large wild creature and the player's smaller creature) and the telegraphs and impacts clearly visible, without trunks, canopy or foliage blocking or washing out the view - and does it look like an event that belongs to the world?
anchors.key_source: ralph/reports/CAMERA/close-1020/f10_2_r3_key.json (set E, capacitor_alpha: A = control, B = candidate_r3)

anchors.judge_brief: Five Meadows sites where the player defeats an enemy-faction trainer. Each row is one site: a 'before' frame (enemy holds the site) then an 'after' frame (same camera after the win). Judge whether each after frame reads as a distinct, believable aftermath particular to that site, with no clutter or artefacts, in the key art's world.
anchors.key_source: ralph/reports/CAMERA/close-1020/f04_6_r22_key.json (judge-time per-site sheets: site-1 riverwatch A=r22, site-2 field A=r22, site-3 relay_captain A=r22, site-4 ridge A=control19, site-5 dell A=control19). The committed composite is re-laid out: columns 1-2 control before/after, columns 3-4 r22 before/after, rows dell, relay_captain, riverwatch, field, ridge.
anchors.blinding_note: Each frame's label strip names the arm ('control'/'r22'); the masks blank them.
